acceptance: Fork/core runbooks and maintenance decision record match the deployed producer/consumer split and explicitly supersede source-review-at-core; no contradictory manual-only or PR-body-oracle promises remain.

Document exact producer contract, consumer checks, credential ownership, cutover, issue ownership, hold/disarm/rollback and artifact-expiry recovery, without token values or new review infrastructure.
Existing documentation/contract checks pass; ordinary fork and core documentation PRs merge without unrelated source/workflow behavior changes.
context: Owner instruction 2026-11-05 supersedes BOTH rejected designs. benchbox-sqlglot owns upstream discovery/integration, fork PR lifecycle, source/relocation/runtime/engine/distribution validation and trustworthy wheel delivery. BenchBox core owns consuming that delivery, origin/identity/hash binding, transactional pin updates, its own wrapper/benchmark-definition/installed-package concerns and ordinary core PR landing. Core must not discover upstream, merge fork PRs, reconstruct/re-review fork source, repeat fork test matrices or acquire a fork-write credential. Theseus stays unchanged and generic; no special policy, external-source inlet, synthetic dataset, second model-review path or reviewer release is needed. Theseus PR25 closed unmerged; prior approval claims withdrawn. This supersedes the source-review-at-core portion of sqlglot-fork-review-h1-governance, not existing protected-branch rules or ordinary review requirements. Preserve exact merged-SHA producer evidence, scoped independent credentials, no candidate execution with write/reviewer secrets, no golden/outcome/test/waiver changes, reviewed rollback, human holds/disarms, reverted-delivery suppression and no public release/cloud spend. Update current fork/core runbooks to this boundary. Corrected proposal: local://sqlglot-end-to-end-proposal.md. The live tracker, not discarded branch code or prior notes, owns delivery state.
description: Update fork downstream/MAINTAINING.md and core release/evidence/maintenance decision documents to actual implemented producer/consumer responsibilities. Explicitly supersede the earlier source-review-at-core-adoption convention from sqlglot-fork-review-h1-governance. Fork owns upstream integration, source/runtime/build verification, verified delivery and upstream exceptions; core trusts that product, validates origin/identity/hash, tests unique core integration/packaging and manages its own adoption PR. Remove claims that pasted fork diffs are reviewed by the core oracle. Do not add Theseus awareness, a new fork review App/required model-review status, duplicate source review or new test matrices. Preserve wheel-only/private namespace, ordinary protection/review policy, rollback, public release controls, scoped actors and cutover/hold/expiry recovery. Runbooks must match deployed workflow locations, schedule, credential ownership and kill switches, not a central core controller that no longer exists.
